# go-modern-strings-bytes-cut-last

**Since:** Go 1.27

## Summary

Use strings.CutLast and bytes.CutLast instead of LastIndex plus manual slicing around the last separator.

## Details

CutLast splits around the final separator and returns before, after, and found.
It removes LastIndex checks and manual separator-length slicing.

## Examples

### Example 1

### Before

```go
i := strings.LastIndex(path, "/")
if i < 0 {
  return "", path, false
}
dir, file := path[:i], path[i+1:]
```

### After

```go
dir, file, found := strings.CutLast(path, "/")
```

### Example 2

### Before 2

```go
i := bytes.LastIndex(line, []byte(":"))
if i < 0 {
  return nil, line, false
}
name, value := line[:i], line[i+1:]
```

### After 2

```go
name, value, found := bytes.CutLast(line, []byte(":"))
```
